game.title: Dragon Age II
game.blurb: Dark fantasy RPG in which Hawke flees a darkspawn invasion and rises to power, with a party of up to three companions and a dialogue wheel, from BioWare, released 2011-03-08. RAWG average playtime: 9 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from the page names on the game's Fandom wiki (no Steam achievement list).

chapters.title: Fleeing the Darkspawn
chapters.summary: Hawke's escape from the darkspawn invasion at the start of the story.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Hawke's rise in Kirkwall, and the clashes between the Qunari, the Templar Order and the Circle of Magi. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Companions, Friendship and Rivalry
chapters.summary: Recruiting companions and how friendship and rivalry with each one grows.

chapters.title: Classes, Combat and Choices
chapters.summary: Mage, warrior and rogue builds, party control and the dialogue wheel.

chapters.title: Crafting and Gear
chapters.summary: Crafting, armour, weapons and item packs.

chapters.title: Downloadable Content
chapters.summary: The add-ons listed on the Fandom wiki's downloadable content page, including Legacy.

attribution: Steam: no achievement list available for this game (see notes)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Dragon_Age_II
Fandom (dragonage.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://dragonage.fandom.com/wiki/Dragon_Age_II
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page at completion stage 0: only its contents page is written, and the Walkthrough is linked but not written, so nothing was used. dragonage.fandom.com answers the API, with about 224 linked pages (including "Companions (Dragon Age II)", "Friendship and Rivalry", "Crafting (Dragon Age II)", "Downloadable content (Dragon Age II)", "Kirkwall", "Lothering" and "Legacy"); names only were looked at, nothing copied, and the chapters follow those page names. The story chapters claim no order of events beyond the opening escape from the darkspawn, which RAWG's description mentions. RAWG's first result is the expected entry (28580, named "Dragon Age 2"); RAWG lists a separate "Dragon Age 2: Legacy" entry. Steam app 1238040 exists, but its achievement schema is empty, so steam is None here; it could be retried later.
